audience: payroll and HR teams that approve time entries and track time off in Wagepoint

useCases.title: Find the company and its people
useCases.text: List the companies this token can access, then get one company. List its people with their name, e-mail, status and hire date.

useCases.title: Review time entries waiting for approval
useCases.text: List the time entries for a date window, filtered by status such as pending. Read which person each entry belongs to.

useCases.title: Check time-off balances
useCases.text: List the time-off balances of everyone in a company, or of one person. Each balance shows the policy name and the current balance.

useCases.title: Review pending time-off requests
useCases.text: List the time-off requests for a date window, filtered by status such as pending. Open one to read its policy and lines.

useCases.title: Approve or reject time entries
useCases.text: Approve, unapprove or reject time entries by id after you check them. This changes payroll approval, so confirm the list first.

useCases.title: Add time entries for one employee
useCases.text: Create time entries for a person with a work date and a duration, such as PT8H. Pass an idempotency key so that a retry is safe.
